/* Generated by pipeline/desk_gadget.py */
.desk-fab { position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; z-index: 900; padding: 10px 18px;
  background: #1c2942; color: #f0c96a; border: 1px solid #c9a227; border-radius: 24px;
  font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; }
.desk-fab:hover { background: #22304f; }
.desk-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1000; }
.desk-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,20,35,.45); }
.desk-modal { position: absolute; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  display: flex; overflow: hidden; }
.desk-full .desk-modal { inset: 4vh 6vw; border-radius: 4px; }
.desk-panel .desk-modal { top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(460px, 96vw); }
.desk-frame { flex: 1; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
.desk-close { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 12px; z-index: 2; background: #1c2942;
  color: #f0c96a; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 9px; cursor: pointer; }
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .desk-full .desk-modal { inset: 0; } .desk-panel .desk-modal { width: 100vw; }
}
